name: ImageBlur
description: Applies a box blur filter to smooth an image by averaging pixel values within a square region. Useful for reducing image noise or creating soft focus effects.

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: blurRadius
params.description:
The size of the blur radius.
Value must be greater than or equal to 3 and less than or equal to 10. The default value is 3.
